additional_concerns: The trigger formula answers only whether an applicable demonstration request has been made. TRUE establishes activation, not fulfillment or SFC satisfaction; FALSE establishes neither compliance nor exemption from confirmation or substantive duties.

Footnote 5 supports a harmonised request-conditioned reading but also permits the stated rival literal reading. The formula implements the selected reading; it does not resolve that interpretive dispute.

The supplied excerpts do not establish a complete substantive performance standard, incident-materiality rule, remediation rule or assessment period. Effective supervision cannot silently become either a sufficient condition or an independently specified paragraph 10 test.

The register-maintenance provisions and the intermediary issuance, due-diligence and control-satisfaction provisions concern distinct actors and duties. Their presence does not establish Product Provider fulfillment or an applicable paragraph 14 request.
Paragraph 15 audit procurement and paragraph 16 legal-opinion procurement require their respective requests. Neither is automatically activated by a demonstration request.
No actual provider-scope or request evidence is supplied. Those classifications remain external judgments. The reported structural validation establishes neither their truth nor legal fidelity.
